text:
marie: FYI were seeing a steady trickle of 2-4 GPU pods getting evicted on eu-central during morning peak.
elliot: same pattern here. mostly tiny-gang jobs landing on 2-slot hosts then preempted within 10-30s when a big training job starts.
marie: scheduler event sample: 
```
Event: preempt
pod: tiny-infer-7 node=eu-central-rack21-shelf2 reason=taint.score>0.9
scheduler_meta: node_slots=2 allocated=2 preemptible=true reschedule_delay=12s
```
fern: network telemetry shows transient conntrack exhaustion on that rack around the same times. nodes get a taint `egress-degraded=true` which triggers preemption.
jamal: cost is noisy: tiny workloads are charged more GPU-hours due to restarts. small-workloads SLO is slipping.
marie: short list of mitigations we can try: 
- add soft anti-affinity for tiny-gangs to avoid 2-slot hosts
- increase taint_tolerance window for transient `egress-degraded`
- add compactPlacement preference for tiny-gang so they pack together instead of scattering
elliot: also consider marking thin-shelves as `no-tiny-workloads` via node-label and prefer warmpool warm nodes that are wider.
fern: metrics to add: `eviction.whiplash.tiny_gang` counter, `scheduler.reschedule_delay_seconds` histogram, and per-rack `conntrack.error_rate`.
ops-bot: autoscaler: +1 node eu-central-rack22 at 2026-03-21T11:02Z (id: sc-22f)
jamal: config draft (sketch): 
```
apiVersion: scheduler.redwood/v1
kind: TinyGangPolicy
metadata:
  name: avoid-thin-shelves
spec:
  avoidThinShelves: true
  thinShelfThresholdSlots: 2
  taintToleranceSeconds: 40
  compactPlacement: true
  preferWarmpoolLabel: tiny-workloads
```
elliot: testing plan: canary 5% in eu-central for 6 hours, run synthetic tiny-gang arrival at 30rps and record whiplash and extra-runtime.
fern: I'll create a toxiproxy job to simulate conntrack spikes and attach logs.
jamal: alert idea: `eviction.whiplash.tiny_gang > 3/min for 5m` -> page on-call. also mute non-actionable chatter.
marie: owners: @elliot do canary rollout, @fern run staging spike tests & post logs, @jamal add metrics+alert, ops-bot to tag autoscaler events.
ops-bot: acknowledged. will append scale and taint events to this thread.
marie: timeline: open PR today, canary tomorrow 05:00 UTC, rollback if evictions > baseline +15% within 6h.
elliot: will include cost delta estimate in PR (expected GPU-hour savings if stable).
jamal: grep helpers: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l app=scheduler -c scheduler | grep -E "preempt|reschedule_delay|taint"`
fern: ping me on the PR for the toxiproxy setup.
marie: thanks team. if canary looks good we promote after 24h soak. :rocket:
